description: Statistics is the branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, and presentation of data. It helps in effectively solving data-based problems for competitive exams.

sections.title: Measures of Central Tendency
sections.description: A single value that indicates the center or middle point of an entire data set.

key_concepts.explanation: Obtained by dividing the sum of all observations by their total number.
The exact middle value when the data is arranged in ascending or descending order.
The value that occurs most frequently in a data set.

sections.title: Measures of Dispersion
sections.description: Measures how spread out or scattered the values in a data set are from their central value.

key_concepts.explanation: The difference between the highest and lowest observation.
The positive square root of the variance that accurately represents the spread of the data.

sections.title: Frequency Distribution
sections.description: A method of organizing large data into various classes where the number of observations (frequency) in each class is provided.

key_concepts.explanation: The cumulative sum of all previous frequencies up to a particular class.

steps.title: Collecting Data
steps.detail: Gather the raw data to be analyzed.

steps.title: Deciding Class Intervals
steps.detail: Choose an appropriate class size according to the total range of the data.

steps.title: Tallying
steps.detail: Count the frequency using tally marks for each data point.

sections.title: Correlation
sections.description: The study of the statistical relationship and its direction between two or more variables.

key_concepts.explanation: Measures how strongly two variables are linked to each other. Its value ranges from -1 to +1.
